entries.name: Goroka
entries.note: Town: provincial capital of Eastern Highlands and the base for the Goroka Show, Asaro Mudmen and Mount Michael; the region's main hub (base).
entries.reason: Goroka, J.K. McCarthy Museum, Asaro Mudmen and Mount Michael make three spots round the base: below four, so no destination; Kainantu (60 km) is beyond a town span.

entries.name: Mount Hagen
entries.note: Town: provincial capital of Western Highlands and the regional air hub (Kagamuga Airport); base for Kuk, Hagen Show, Baiyer River and Mount Hagen Market.
entries.reason: Mount Hagen and the Western Highlands Cultural Centre only (Baiyer River, Kuk and the market are reviews): standalone.

entries.name: Kainantu
entries.note: Town: market town on the Highlands Highway with the Eastern Highlands Cultural Centre and pottery; a stop between Lae and Goroka.
entries.reason: With the Eastern Highlands Cultural Centre only two places: standalone.

entries.name: Mendi
entries.note: Town: provincial capital of Southern Highlands; gateway to Lake Kutubu and Mount Giluwe, with a Friday and Saturday market.
entries.reason: Mendi, Lake Kutubu and Mount Giluwe: Lake Kutubu is 50 km out, so below four: standalone.

entries.name: Kundiawa
entries.note: Town: capital of Simbu (Chimbu) Province; the departure point for the Mount Wilhelm climb, reached from Keglsugl.
entries.reason: Kundiawa and Mount Wilhelm only: standalone.

entries.name: Tari
entries.note: Town: capital of Hela Province and base for the Huli wigmen, Tari Basin and Ambua Lodge. No Wikivoyage article exists (404).
entries.reason: Standalone town (Huli wigmen base, no other kept spot nearby).

entries.name: Mount Wilhelm
entries.coordinates_source: osm natural=peak node (MEDIUM; Wikipedia coordinates are rounded)
entries.note: Mountain: Papua New Guinea's highest peak (4,509 m), climbed by guided treks from Keglsugl (Simbu) or Ambullua (Western Highlands).
entries.reason: Summit of PNG; pinned on the OSM peak. Standalone.

entries.name: Mount Giluwe
entries.note: Mountain: second-highest peak in PNG (4,368 m), a shield volcano with guided climbs, in Southern Highlands.

entries.name: Mount Michael
entries.note: Mountain: cloud-forest hill near Goroka with hiking trails and highland views. The Wikipedia title Mount Michael is the South Sandwich Islands volcano, so it is not used.

entries.name: Lake Kutubu
entries.note: Lake: 800 m upland lake, about 50 km southwest of Mendi, with Ramsar status and endemic fish; reached by road and boat.

entries.name: Asaro Mudmen
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Cultural attraction: masked mud-men performers from the Asaro people, who live in a village near Goroka; the tourism board names the village performances.
entries.reason: Three-spot Goroka cluster: standalone. Village performance, pin needed.

entries.name: Eastern Highlands Cultural Centre and Museum
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Museum: cultural centre and museum at Kainantu, known for its pottery and the Kainantu pottery and weaving markets. No dedicated Wikipedia article found.
entries.reason: Two places at Kainantu: standalone. Pin needed.

entries.name: J.K. McCarthy Museum
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Museum: Goroka museum on Airport Road with WWII relics, traditional artefacts and 1930s photos of the first Australian patrols into the Highlands. Hours variable per Wikivoyage.

entries.name: Taekanda Cultural Centre
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Museum: Enga cultural centre near Wabag with wigs, war shields, masks and a sand-painting workshop. No Wikipedia article found.
entries.reason: Standalone near Wabag (Wabag is a review); pin needed.

entries.name: Western Highlands Cultural Centre
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Museum: cultural centre in Mount Hagen with a reconstructed village hut and artefacts. No Wikipedia article found.

reviews.name: Wabag
reviews.reason: Enga capital named on the tourism board page and in Wikivoyage's Highlands guide, but the page lists no sight in the town itself; the draws (Yuo Falls, Laiagam, Taekanda Cultural Centre) are elsewhere. For: provincial hub and gateway. Against: nothing to do in town for half an hour. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Mount Ialibu
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board names tracks around the 3,465 m peak next to Giluwe (opened southern-highlands page), but nothing on route, access or guides; one source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named mountain in a province page's headline sentence. Against: single source, no description, region under advisory, rarely visited.

reviews.name: Mount Hagen (volcano)
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Mount Hagen 'Do' lists it among climbs but says 'not much is known, climb them and document'; one source, no infrastructure.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the mountain the city is named after, 24 km away. Against: no track info, no guide, advisory area; an unknown climb is not a visitor draw.

reviews.name: Toi Wara Waterfall
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage Mount Hagen Do listing gives a detailed adventurous visit (swim, walk behind falls) but needs a four-hour drive and steep gorge trail with local helpers; one source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: detailed named listing with a clear half-day activity. Against: one source, remote, Southern Highlands is under travel advisories, hard to find.

reviews.name: Wasi Falls
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board 'must see' for the Southern Highlands (100 m fall in a Wildlife Management Area), reached on guided tours from Lakwanda; one source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: headline must-see. Against: one source, no detail on access, advisory area.

reviews.name: Yuo Falls
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board's Enga page names a 15-minute hike to the falls from Wabag; one source, short visit.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: easy named hike near the provincial capital. Against: one source, short visit, no description.

reviews.name: Bisil Kana Waterfall
reviews.reason: Rule 1: tourism board 'must see' (river bursting from a mountain face, 10 m wide); one source, location and access not given.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: named natural wonder. Against: single source, vague access, no images or Wikipedia.

reviews.name: Kuk Early Agricultural Site
reviews.reason: UNESCO World Heritage swamp gardens named by Wikivoyage Mount Hagen and the tourism board, but visitors need permission and there is little to see on site. For: world-heritage draw a guide names. Against: access is by arrangement and the visible remains are slight. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Baiyer River Sanctuary
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: a 740 ha bird-of-paradise sanctuary 40 km from Mount Hagen; Wikivoyage has no page and the tourism pages opened do not name it, so only Wikipedia (not counted) and travel-article mentions; facilities reportedly destroyed.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a recognised bird-of-paradise reserve and Wikipedia tourist attraction. Against: no counted source found, uncertain facilities and access, advisory area.

reviews.name: Mount Hagen Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1/4: Wikivoyage See listing (with coordinates) for the main produce market, but trading days are not stated and the tourism board mentions 'Saturday markets'; one source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named See listing, a daily market would be fine. Against: days unconfirmed, a once-weekly market would fail rule 4; advisory area.

reviews.name: Mendi Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1/4: tourism board names it for Imbonggu baskets, 'best visited Fridays and Saturdays when the full force of vendors comes', implying it trades other days; one source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the one named craft market in the Southern Highlands. Against: peak days weekly, one source, advisory area.

reviews.name: Banz Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1/4: tourism board calls it the biggest and best market in Jiwaka; one source and trading days not given.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a must-see in the only Jiwaka page. Against: may be a weekly market, which fails rule 4; one source.

reviews.name: Kurumul Tea Plantation
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board must-see (pick tea leaves on a 2,000 ha estate); one source, unknown whether open to casual visits.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a distinctive hands-on activity. Against: a working estate, access and hours unstated, one source.

reviews.name: Nambaiyufa Amphitheatre
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board names rock paintings and Keu Caves near Chuave; one source, no access or description.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named cultural-archaeological site. Against: one source, no access details, little known.

reviews.name: Kemase Caves
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: limestone caves with prehistoric paintings at Kemase village, visited through Kemase Eco Tourism, a tourism-board-listed partner; one source and guided only.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the specific place behind the Lufa cave-art recommendation. Against: single source, village-arranged access only.

reviews.name: Laiagam Botanical Gardens
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board 'must see' (100+ native orchids and rhododendrons); I did not find it in Wikivoyage Highlands, so one counted source.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a garden open to stroll and a must-see list entry. Against: one source, upkeep and access unknown.

reviews.name: Laiagam Salt Ponds
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: tourism board names a visit; one source, no description, visit length unknown.
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: distinctive natural/cultural site named for the Enga visit. Against: sketchy information, one source.

note: PNG has no existing destinations or spots. Placement run jointly for all nine regions; proposed destinations are in curation/png/destinations-proposed.json.
